methodologyNotes: Covers self-powered (active) home-audio and home-theater subwoofers with a built-in amplifier, sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes passive subwoofers (no onboard amp), car/marine subwoofers, and professional PA/touring subs. Price is US MSRP or typical street price in USD. driverSizeIn is the nominal active driver diameter in inches (largest single driver; passive radiators noted in provenance, not counted here). amplifierPowerRmsW is manufacturer-rated continuous/RMS amplifier power in watts. amplifierPowerPeakW is rated peak/dynamic power in watts, or null if not disclosed. enclosureType is an enum: sealed | ported | passive-radiator | bandpass (switchable designs listed by their default mode, alternates noted in provenance). frequencyResponseHz is the rated range as a 'low to high' string in Hz at the manufacturer's stated tolerance (e.g. +/-3 dB). amplifierClass is an enum: class-d | class-ab | class-h | bash. driverOrientation is an enum: front-firing | down-firing | side-firing | up-firing. roomCorrection is a boolean: true if the sub ships with onboard automatic room EQ or app-based calibration. wirelessInput is a boolean: true if a wireless line-level connection is included or offered as a first-party option. dimensionsIn is the cabinet size as an 'H x W x D' string in inches. weightLbs is unit weight in pounds.
